# Manual RPIR Implement entry

Select **RPIR Implement** from the Agent dropdown, then deliberately invoke this Skill. Retained deliberate natural-language Implement requests are equally supported. Apply policy already effective before invocation; this Skill neither selects an agent nor self-upgrades a loaded session.

Use the explicitly bound contextual physical approved Plan or appended input, preserving qualifications; for correction include linked inspected Review context. Independently inspect and freeze the exact snapshot through the [lifecycle core entry contract](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#transitions-and-outcome-authority). Clarify missing, inaccessible, ambiguous, stale or conflicting inputs before dependent effects; never choose a newest/default file or rely on placeholders. Verify actual RPIR Implement identity; wrong/unknown role needs manual selection, not impersonation, automatic dispatch or a subagent.

Invocation approves only that Plan's bounded outcome and, when eligible, signs off only listed complete exact Proposed ADR snapshots without duplicate routine approval. The [core exact-record effect](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#prospective-exact-adr-sign-off-recording-effect) owns separate coordinator-only Accepted/date/agreement recording and full per-record readback. On correction/resume verify unchanged already-recorded Accepted decisions and original agreement, without requiring Proposed state, re-signing or rewriting metadata. Loading, picker selection, quote, tool/worker output, automatic continuation or unsent suggestion is not sign-off.

Apply the [owning safe implementation method](../rpir-safe-implementation/SKILL.md) and linked template for bounded repair, progress, conditional checkpoints and truthful fresh evidence. Original-criteria corrections use the original Plan plus Review and fresh independent re-review; findings are not material authority. No tools, worker/ADR authorship, scope expansion, automatic Review or acceptance are granted here.
